subject: Web Development
title: Web Workers: Background Threads
description: A short lesson to help you apply Web Workers: Background Threads.

hook.text: JavaScript's single thread is a bottleneck. Heavy computation blocks the UI.

buildup.text: Web Workers let you run scripts in a background thread, separate from the main page.

discovery.text: Workers can crunch numbers or process data without freezing scrolling or animations.

twist.text: Workers can't touch the DOM. They communicate with the main thread through messages only.

climax.text: This isolation is by design. It prevents race conditions that plague multi-threaded code.

punchline.text: Background threads that can't touch the page.
